description: Search or browse Sephora products, fetch product URLs, exports reviews or questions. Choose a mode, then set keywords, categories, brands, market, filters and optional detail enrichment.

brands.description: Brand names, slugs or Sephora brand URLs (mode=brand; also an optional filter in other listing modes). Example: `Rare Beauty` or `/brand/rare-beauty-by-selena-gomez`.
brands.title: Brands

categories.description: Category slugs, `cat...` IDs or Sephora category URLs (mode=category, bestsellers, newArrivals, sale; also a filter in search). Empty browse modes use the six top-level categories.
categories.title: Categories

includeBestsellersOnly.description: Only include products flagged as bestsellers in listing modes. Not available in product-URL mode.
includeBestsellersOnly.title: Bestsellers only

includeDetails.description: Fetch descriptions, ingredients, highlights, variants, stock, category path and brand information for every product in listing modes. Product-URL mode always includes details.
includeDetails.title: Include product details

includeImages.description: Copy product images into the run's key-value store so the image links stay publicly accessible.
includeImages.title: Include rehosted images

includeNewOnly.description: Only include products Sephora flags as new.
includeNewOnly.title: New products only

includeQuestions.description: Add questions with their answers to product records, and fetch question rows in questions mode.
includeQuestions.title: Include questions and answers

includeReviewStats.description: Add the rating histogram, recommendation counts, review dates and GTIN/UPC/EAN identifiers.
includeReviewStats.title: Include review statistics

includeReviews.description: Add recent or most-helpful review samples to product records, and fetch review samples in reviews mode.
includeReviews.title: Include review samples

market.description: Storefront and currency: United States (USD), Canada English (CAD) or Canada French (CAD).
market.title: Market

maxImagesPerProduct.description: Maximum number of product images to keep and rehost for each product.
maxImagesPerProduct.title: Maximum images per product

maxItems.description: Hard cap on all records emitted by the run.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Cap records per keyword, category, brand or product URL. 0 means no per-source cap.
maxItemsPerQuery.title: Maximum records per source

maxQuestionsPerProduct.description: Maximum question rows or embedded questions per product.
maxQuestionsPerProduct.title: Maximum questions per product

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum review rows or samples per product.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Maximum reviews per product

minRating.description: Only include products rated at or above this value (1-5).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to fetch: keyword search, category or brand browse, product URLs, bestsellers, new arrivals, sale, reviews or questions.
enumTitles: Questions and answers for product URLs
mode.title: Mode

onlyNewProducts.description: Skip product IDs that were already returned under the same state key in earlier runs.
onlyNewProducts.title: Only new products

priceMax.description: Only include products whose current price is at or below this amount, in the selected market's currency.
priceMax.title: Maximum price

priceMin.description: Only include products whose current price is at or above this amount, in the selected market's currency.
priceMin.title: Minimum price

productUrls.description: Sephora product URLs or `P...` IDs (mode=product, reviews, questions). A `?skuId=` in the URL selects that variant.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Sephora's public catalog and review endpoints work without a proxy.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

refinements.description: Optional Sephora facet values, e.g. `filters[skinType]=drySk` or `filters[ingredientPreferences]=crueltyFree`. Up to 20.
refinements.title: Advanced refinements

resetState.description: Forget previously seen product IDs for this state key before the run.
resetState.title: Reset saved state

reviewsSort.description: Ordering for review rows and review samples.
reviewsSort.title: Review order

saleOnly.description: Only include products currently discounted by Sephora.
saleOnly.title: On sale only

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search (mode=search). Enter one or more terms, e.g. `moisturizer`, `vitamin c serum`.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sortBy.description: Result ordering for listing modes. Bestsellers and sale default to best selling; new arrivals default to newest.
sortBy.title: Sort order

stateKey.description: Name for the saved product-ID state used by 'Only new products'.
stateKey.title: State key

title: Sephora Catalog Price & Rating Finder Input
